## What's changed

- Added native Android TV playback planning using the player’s current display, decoder, and audio-output capabilities.
- Kept compatible video direct when only its audio needs conversion, avoiding an unnecessary full video transcode.
- Converted audio alongside genuinely transcoded video to keep long-running Android TV playback synchronized on one timeline.
- Preserved AAC 5.1 when the connected output supports surround sound, while using reliable stereo for built-in television speakers.
- Preserved supported 4K HDR10 output when Android TV must convert an HDR video, without changing Steam or retro-player playback paths.
